prompt: Create a photorealistic architectural interior rendering of a modern Japanese-inspired living room and small work area, viewed from a fixed wide-angle camera at standing eye level from the front-left corner looking diagonally into the room. The space has warm walnut wood flooring, smooth off-white plaster walls, a muted beige ceiling, and a dark charcoal stone-textured accent wall on the right. Along the left wall place exactly 6 tall narrow vertical windows with black frames, bringing in soft overcast daylight and faint suburban houses and greenery outside. In the foreground place a low, long L-shaped sofa in warm taupe woven fabric with wooden legs and exactly 3 visible cushions: one large back cushion section, one chaise seat section, and two loose square throw pillows near the corner. In front of it place a rectangular mid-century wooden coffee table with rounded corners, tapered legs, a lower woven shelf, exactly 2 stacked books, and 1 small potted green plant. On the right accent wall mount 1 large thin flat-screen TV with a dark screen and slim gray side frame. Toward the back center, create a compact raised work nook partially hidden by a white structural wall, with exactly 1 wooden desk, 1 black ergonomic mesh office chair, 1 computer monitor, 1 small desk lamp, and warm wood flooring continuing through the area. At the rear-right, add a decorative partition of exactly 10 vertical wooden slats in front of a large black-framed window, with a small built-in shelf holding exactly 3 tiny decor items or plants. Use black ceiling track lighting with exactly 5 visible spotlights distributed along two tracks, turned on subtly but dominated by natural daylight. Overall style: minimal warm modern Japanese with mid-century wood furniture, realistic materials, clean uncluttered staging, balanced neutral tones, soft shadows, high-end residential design visualization, no people, no text, no logos, no exaggerated decoration.

promptZh: 创建一个现代日式风格客厅及小型工作区的写实建筑室内渲染图，视角为从左前方站立视平线处向室内对角线拍摄的固定广角镜头。空间采用暖色调胡桃木地板、平滑的灰白色抹灰墙面、柔和的米色天花板，右侧为深炭灰色石材纹理的背景墙。沿左侧墙壁放置 6 扇高窄垂直窗户，配有黑色边框，引入柔和的阴天自然光，窗外可见模糊的郊区房屋和绿植。前景处放置一张低矮的长款 L 型沙发，材质为 暖灰褐色编织面料，配有木质沙发腿，并清晰可见 3 个靠垫：一个大型靠背垫、一个贵妃位坐垫以及转角处两个松散的方形抱枕。沙发前放置一张长方形中世纪风格木质咖啡桌，带有圆角、锥形桌腿、下层编织搁板，桌上摆放 2 本叠放的书籍和 1 盆小型绿植。右侧背景墙上安装 1 台大型超薄平板电视，屏幕呈黑色，配有纤细的灰色侧边框。在后方中央区域，打造一个由白色结构墙部分遮挡的紧凑型抬高式工作角，内设 1 张木质书桌、1 把黑色人体工学网布办公椅、1 台电脑显示器、1 盏小型台灯，暖色木地板延伸至该区域。在右后方，增加一个装饰性隔断，由 10 根垂直木板条组成，置于一扇大型黑框窗户前，并配有一个小型内置搁板，上面摆放 3 件精致的装饰品或小植物。使用黑色天花板轨道灯，轨道上可见 5 个射灯，灯光微亮，但以自然光为主。整体风格：极简温馨现代日式风格，搭配中世纪木质家具，材质真实，陈设整洁，中性色调平衡，阴影柔和，高端住宅设计可视化，无人物，无文字，无 Logo，无夸张装饰。
